change_log.summary: Improve reviewer-memory retrieval clarity and robustness
details: Diagnosis: The memory program returned terse lists of past reviewer lessons/facts but lacked a concise summary and could produce overly long, less focused outputs for reviewers needing quick, same-dimension guidance. This makes retrieval noisy and occasionally unstable across runs.

Specific change: Enhance KnowledgeBase.read() to include a short summary (count of available same-dimension memories and top lessons), better fallback to GENERAL, and stricter trimming to 3000 chars. Also ensure write() bounds per-dimension storage to avoid unbounded growth.

change_log.summary: Improve memory management and add debug logging in KnowledgeBase
details: Diagnosis: Large and unbounded per-dimension and global memory growth made retrieval noisy and risked excessive context; lack of runtime logging reduced traceability of writes/reads.
Specific change: Add global storage cap and trimming, emit toolkit.logger.debug calls on writes and reads, and improve empty-retrieval messaging. Preserve existing read formatting and 3000-char cap.

change_log.summary: Add simple query-summary cache and avoid unnecessary LLM calls to stabilize read()
details: Diagnosis: Some rotating-validation failures were caused by excessive or repeated LLM calls and occasional transient LLM errors; long prompts also risk hitting model/timeout limits. The read() path always invoked the LLM even when a short history or repeated query could be answered from local data, increasing instability.

Specific change: Add a small in-memory cache keyed by (dimension, query_text) to return recent summaries without calling the LLM; skip the LLM when the balanced history is already short and return it directly. Improve robustness by validating the LLM result and falling back to trimmed history. This reduces LLM usage, shortens prompts, and makes read() more stable while preserving behavior.

change_log.summary: Add caching and safe LLM usage to memory read; avoid unnecessary LLM calls
details: Diagnosis: rotating-validation failures traced to nondeterministic or excessive LLM calls during MemoryProgram.read and long prompts causing timeouts / variability. The parent lacked any caching and always invoked llm_completion even when history was short, increasing churn and risk of failure.

Change: add a small in-memory summary cache, skip LLM when history is short (return trimmed history), and guard LLM invocation with existence check and try/except; cap stored summaries and ensure single LLM invocation per read for stability.

change_log.summary: Improve memory retrieval robustness and observability for ORIG reviews
details: Diagnosis: Retrieval sometimes lacked operational observability and unbounded per-dimension storage could grow large; having no debug trace makes diagnosing failures harder during review generation.

Specific change: Reduce per-dimension retention cap to bound memory, and add a defensive debug log in read() to surface retrieval decisions (requested dimension, count returned). Keep returned text trimmed to 3000 chars.
